title: Great day, Challenge for old knees
text:
A great way to spend a day when you have the time. The olive Mill owner was friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful and all of his products were delicious. I think everybody on our tour bought some! We enjoyed seeing some of the very small villages before Ronda. Just walking down a couple of those streets will be a challenge for older peoples knees. 
Our guide Maria was also very knowledgeable and gave great advice to maximize time in Ronda.
author: B4307PAbarbarac

title: Countryside drive, picturesque villages and the wonder of Ronda
text: The drive takes place along windy roads that give way to surprising vistas. There are two stops along the way to Ronda, one for coffee and the second for lunch. We spent about two hours at Ronda which was enough to capture lots of great photos and even to do a little shopping. It was a day well spent!
author: Margaret_B

title: White villages and Ronda
text: The time in Ronda is limited but the stops are worthwhile and Ronda is very busy and touristic. Roads are narrow and windy.

title: Don't miss this one!
text: A really great day.  Saw a lot of beautiful landscapes and towns.  Our guide Antonio was wonderful and our driver Rafael was amazing.  Would highly recommend.  Sometimes these tours aren't worth the money but this one really was.

title: I highly recommend this as an excellent day trip!
text: This is a great day trip from Sevilla to explore Ronda and the white villages of Zahara and Grazalema. The drive to each place offered an awe-inspiring view of the landscape - rolling hills of sunflower farms and olive orchards. The tour was well organized, and the local tour group contacted us via WhatsApp the day before to provide essential reminders, such as the meet-up location. Loren and our bus driver, Rafa, were both excellent. Loren shared relevant historical information and events during our journey to each city.
